subject.title: feat(openclaw): support pinning release version via openclaw_version

question: Should this installer officially support an opt-in `openclaw_version` pin that trades automatic updates for reproducible release deployments?
rationale: The patch is focused and proof-backed, but accepting it defines the supported update and mode-switch contract for production users rather than repairing an already documented broken behavior.

options.title: Sponsor the opt-in pinning contract
options.body: Merge the documented `latest`-by-default configuration so fleet operators can deliberately pin and roll releases forward.

options.title: Keep latest-only release mode
options.body: Decline the new configuration surface and continue treating every release-mode converge as an update to the current npm latest tag.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the opt-in pinning contract
recommendation.body: Merge the documented `latest`-by-default configuration so fleet operators can deliberately pin and roll releases forward.

likelyOwner.reason: This person or group owns the current release-mode installer behavior and must choose its supported production update contract.
